Case diary is perused.
This is first application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.
Applicant apprehends his arrest in connection wi

In brief, the prosecution case is that on 21.04.2022 prosecutrix lodged a computerized complaint against Ramu Mahant, Avdesh Sharma, Suresh Sharma, Vinod Sharma and Umesh Singh regarding Chandrashekhar @ Vinod Tomar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145852636/

sentences.text: As per computerized complaint, due to dispute with her husband without informing him, she came from his house.
Her husband lodged a gumshudgi report.
When she came to know about the report, she herself remained present at the police station and informed the police officer that she does not want to live with her husband.
Thereafter, on her report, she was sent to Nari-niketan, she stayed there for three days.
Thereafter, on 04.05.2022 she was present before Collectorate.
Thereafter, on 05.05.2022 she was released from Nari-niketan.

Thereafter, alongwith Ramu Mahant she had gone to village Tharet,
District Datia.
There Ramu Mahant told her that she should remain here for some period.
He will see that there will be compromise between her and her husband.

On the assurance of Ramu Mahant,
she started living in the house.

For one to two days he kept her properly, thereafter, he has started misbehaving her and made physical relationship forcefully alogwith his friend Avdesh Sharma,
Vinod Singh, Umesh Singh and Suresh Sharma.
They used to come and made forcefully physical relationship with her.
With dire consequence, she lodged a report at police station that she will be killed.
Her husband on 20.07.2022 went to Police Station Datia and informed about the incident.
Her statements were recorded by police.
There she has stated that she want to go with her husband.
On her report, aforesaid offence was registered.
During statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. in which she has alleged that applicant-accused made physical relationship in the house of Neha
. There were two bodyguards present outside the house of Neha.
Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.

The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
With the aforesaid, the present application stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE Adnan Chandrashekhar @ Vinod Tomar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145852636/
